title: PROOF_AUDIT.json - step-by-step derivation proof verification
description: Produced by /theory-derivation (step-by-step proof verification) per artifact-registry.md. Shape follows the Required Audit Artifact Schema in shared-references/assurance-contract.md (the skill defines no narrower one). audited_input_hashes is mandatory per artifact-registry.md schema invariant 2.

audited_input_hashes.description: SHA256 of every file the audit consumed (filename -> sha256). Verifier rehashes and flags STALE on mismatch.

trace_path.description: Directory containing the full reviewer prompt + response pair (required for mandatory audits).

thread_id.description: Reviewer provider thread ID. Optional: assurance-contract lists it in the minimum block but OSS is single-agent and the kill-argument sample omits it.
